# lago_customer (Resource)

Manages a Lago customer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_tax" "vat" {
  name = "VAT"
  code = "vat_20"
  rate = 20.0
}

resource "lago_customer" "acme" {
  external_id   = "acme-corp-001"
  name          = "Acme Corporation"
  email         = "billing@acme.example.com"
  phone         = "+1-555-000-0000"
  customer_type = "company"
  currency      = "USD"
  timezone      = "America/New_York"

  address_line1 = "123 Main Street"
  address_line2 = "Suite 400"
  city          = "New York"
  state         = "NY"
  zipcode       = "10001"
  country       = "US"

  legal_name                = "Acme Corporation Inc."
  legal_number              = "12-3456789"
  tax_identification_number = "US123456789"

  net_payment_term             = 30
  finalize_zero_amount_invoice = "skip"

  tax_codes = [lago_tax.vat.code]

  billing_configuration {
    invoice_grace_period  = 3
    payment_provider      = "stripe"
    payment_provider_code = "stripe_us"
    provider_customer_id  = "cus_abc123"
    sync_with_provider    = true
    document_locale       = "en"

    provider_payment_methods = ["card", "us_bank_account"]
  }

  shipping_address {
    address_line1 = "456 Warehouse Blvd"
    city          = "Newark"
    state         = "NJ"
    zipcode       = "07101"
    country       = "US"
  }

  metadata {
    key                = "salesforce_id"
    value              = "0015000000XXXXAAA"
    display_in_invoice = false
  }

  metadata {
    key                = "plan_tier"
    value              = "enterprise"
    display_in_invoice = true
  }
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_id` (String) Your application's unique identifier for the customer. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `address_line1` (String) First line of the customer's billing address.
- `address_line2` (String) Second line of the customer's billing address.
- `billing_configuration` (Attributes) Customer billing configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing_configuration))
- `city` (String) City of the customer's billing address.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166 country code of the customer's billing address.
- `currency` (String) Currency code for the customer (e.g. `USD`).
- `customer_type` (String) Customer type. Allowed values: `company`, `individual`.
- `email` (String) Customer email address.
- `finalize_zero_amount_invoice` (String) Controls zero-amount invoice behaviour. Allowed values: `finalize`, `skip`, `inherit`.
- `legal_name` (String) Customer's legal entity name.
- `legal_number` (String) Customer's legal registration number.
- `metadata` (Attributes List) Custom metadata attached to the customer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `name` (String) Customer full name.
- `net_payment_term` (Number) Net payment term in days.
- `phone` (String) Customer phone number.
- `shipping_address` (Attributes) Customer shipping address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_address))
- `state` (String) State or region of the customer's billing address.
- `tax_codes` (Set of String) List of tax codes to apply to the customer.
- `tax_identification_number` (String) Customer's tax identification number (VAT, GST, etc.).
- `timezone` (String) Customer timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`).
- `url` (String) Customer website URL.
- `zipcode` (String) Postal code of the customer's billing address.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Customer creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the customer `external_id`.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the customer.
- `updated_at` (String) Customer last update timestamp (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--billing_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `billing_configuration`

Optional:

- `document_locale` (String) Locale for customer documents (e.g. `en`).
- `invoice_grace_period` (Number) Grace period in days before an invoice is finalised.
- `payment_provider` (String) Payment provider identifier (e.g. `stripe`, `adyen`, `gocardless`).
- `payment_provider_code` (String) Code of the payment provider integration.
- `provider_customer_id` (String) Customer ID on the payment provider side.
- `provider_payment_methods` (Set of String) Payment methods enabled for the customer on the payment provider.
- `sync_with_provider` (Boolean) Whether to sync the customer with the payment provider (write-only; not read back from API).


<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `key` (String) Metadata key.
- `value` (String) Metadata value.

Optional:

- `display_in_invoice` (Boolean) Whether to display this metadata on invoices.


<a id="nestedatt--shipping_address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_address`

Optional:

- `address_line1` (String) First line of the shipping address.
- `address_line2` (String) Second line of the shipping address.
- `city` (String) City of the shipping address.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166 country code of the shipping address.
- `state` (String) State or region of the shipping address.
- `zipcode` (String) Postal code of the shipping address.
